spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (सुखयति)
To make happy.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खं)
1 Happy, joyful, delighted.
2 Virtuous, pious.
3 Easy, practicable.
n. (-खं)
1 Happiness, pleasure, delight.
2 Heaven, paradise.
3 Water.
f. (-खा)
The capital of VARUṆA.
E.
सु good, excellent, ख an organ of sense.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Conferring happiness.
2 Doing any thing easily.
3 Done easily.
E.
सुख, and कर who or what makes.

m. (-णः)
A kind of weapon or staff with which ŚIVA is armed.

m. (-रः)
An excellent horse.
E.
सुख pleasure, चर to go, aff. अण्.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Easily to be cut or destroyed.
E.
सुख, and छेद्य to be cut or cut off.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Happy, taking pleasure.
2 Born or produced easily.
E.
सुख, and जात born.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Conferring or affording pleasure, &c.
f. (-दा)
A courtezan of INDRA'S heaven.
n. (-दं)
The seat of VIṢṆU.
E.
सुख pleasure, दा to give, affs. अङ् and टाप्.

f. (-ह्या)
A cow easily milked.
E.
सुख (with) pleasure, दोह्य to be milked.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Hoping or expecting happiness.
E.
सुख, and प्रति before ईक्ष to see, ण aff.

m. (-गः)
Happiness, good fortune.
E.
सुख, and भाग share.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
Happy, delighted.
E.
सुखभाग, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Easily broken or disunited.
E.
सुख, and भेद्य to be broken.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Full or consisting of happiness, delightful.
E.
सुख, and मयट् aff.

m. (-कः)
Natron, alkali.
E.
सुख pleasure, बर्च्च to shine, aff. क्वुन्.

m. (-नः)
Perfume for the mouth.
E.
सुख pleasure, and वासन perfuming; also मुखवासन and शुभवासन.

n. (-नं)
Consciousness of pleasure.
E.
सुख, and वेदन knowing.

f. (-ह्या)
A tractable and gentle cow, one easily milked.
E.
see the next.

f. (-ह्या)
A tractable cow, one easily and quickly milked.
E.
सुख pleasure, सम् before दुह to milk, ण्यत् aff.; also with क्यप् aff. सुखसंदुह्या as above.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
1 Easy of accomplishment or attainment.
2 Easy of cure.
3 Easy to be discomfited.
E.
सुख, and साध्य to be broken.

mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं)
Gratifying, agreeable to the touch or feelings.
E.
सुख, and स्पर्श touch.

m. (-रः)
Svarga, the heaven of INDRA, and paradise of the Hindus.
E.
सुख pleasure, and आधार a receptacle or reservoir.

m. (-वः)
Anticipation or consciousness of pleasure.
E.
सुख, and अनुभव perception.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Wishing well, friendly, attached.
2 Subversive of happiness.
E.
सुख, and अन्त end.

m. (-तः)
An excellent and well-trained horse.
E.
सुख pleasure, and आयत restrained.

m. (-नः)
A good horse.
E.
सुख pleasure, and अयन going.

n. adv. (-र्थं)
For the sake of ease, happiness, &c.
E.
सुख, and अर्थम् on account of.

mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि)
Seeking or wishing for happiness.
E.
सुख, and अर्थिन् seeking.

m. (-रः)
A deified teacher of the Bauddhas.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Conferring pleasure, delighting, pleasing.
E.
सुख pleasure, आङ् before वह to convey, aff. अच्.

m. (-शः)
1 VARUṆA, deity of water.
2 A cucumber, (Cucumis sativus.)
3 Eating with pleasure, feeding on dainties, &c.
E.
सुख pleasure, अश to eat, अच् aff.

m. (-कः)
The common cucumber.
E.
सुखाश the same, and कन् added.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Seated or sitting at ease.
E.
सुख, and आसीन seated.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Well-flavoured.
2 Delightful, agreeable.
m. (-दः)
1

Enjoyment.
2

Flavour.
E.
सुख, and आस्वाद taste.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Conferring pleasure, agreeable, delightful.
E.
सुख and आङ् before हृ to take, अच् aff.

mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि)
Happy, pleasant, possessing happiness or pleasure.
m. (-खी)
A Yati or religious ascetic.
E.
सुख pleasure, इनि poss. aff.

m. (-वः)
A happy or contented disposition.
E.
सुखिन्, and स्वभाव nature.

f. (-च्छा)
Hope or desire of happiness.
E.
सुख, and इच्छा wish.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Wishing well to, seeking another's happiness.
E.
सुख, and एषिन् who wishes.

m. (-वः)
A husband.
E.
सुख pleasure, and उत्सव a festival.

m. (-यः)
Realization or occurrence of pleasure.
E.
सुख, and उदय arising.

mfn. (-र्कः-र्का-र्कं)
Yielding or leading to happiness or pleasure.
E.
सुख, and उदर्क consequence.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
To be uttered easily or agreeably.
E.
सुख, and उद्य to be spoken.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Seated comfortably or at ease.
E.
सुख, and उपविष्ट seated.

mfn. (-र्प्यः-र्प्या-र्प्यं)
Easy of access.
E.
सुख, and उपसर्प्य to be approached.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Celebrated, famous.
E.
सु, and ख्यात renowned.

f. (-तिः)
Fame, celebrity.
E.
सु, and ख्याति fame.
